Compute QC metrics for a motion estimate

Source: R/qc.R
motion_qc.Rd

Compute QC metrics for a motion estimate

Usage

motion_qc(
  x,
  motion,
  corrected = NULL,
  mask = NULL,
  cost_init = NULL,
  cost_final = NULL
)

Arguments

x

Original 4D image-like input.

motion

Motion matrix (nt x 6).

corrected

Optional corrected 4D data.

mask

Optional 3D mask.

cost_init

Optional initial costs.

cost_final

Optional final costs.

Value

A list of QC metrics.
